scope.method: Compared both freeze file inventories, verified every v9 file size and SHA-256, read corrected tests and their owning production contracts, and inspected preserved full-gate and focused-test receipts. No Git, source edits, Cargo/build/bake/GPU/native jobs or target writes. This new receipt is the sole write.

findings.result: Correct root fix for an obsolete revision pin.
findings.evidence: The assertion pins owning Geometry7. Independent compiler and lighting fingerprint comparisons still require revision+1 to change both keys; both same-input purity assertions remain. No fingerprint assertion was removed or weakened.

findings.result: Correct explicit setup for the current prepared catalog provenance contract.
findings.evidence: Asset-less open_at(..., None) still must succeed with the Demo level id. An empty installed root must fail specifically for the missing package catalog. The test copies the prepared catalog and checks the complete copy byte count, then requires the distinct named missing-dependency rejection. Production open_at verifies the installed catalog SHA before asset dependencies; no missing-catalog or dependency exemption was introduced.

Final package/native/visual/resource/memory and recovered-world acceptance must use their genuine completed receipts; this source-only review does not certify those outcomes.
